result.note: Tests the strait whose reopening let India lift emergency gas allocation restrictions in July 2026; the brief item supports one question.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India lifted emergency gas allocation restrictions after liquefied natural gas shipments resumed through which reopened waterway?
questions.explain: India lifted the restrictions on 6 July 2026, after LNG shipments resumed through a reopened Strait of Hormuz. The emergency curbs on gas allocation were eased once these supplies started moving again.
questions.source: India lifted emergency gas allocation restrictions after liquefied natural gas shipments resumed through a reopened Strait of Hormuz.
